1349-6797-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.

Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 6.
Repeat.

Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.

Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Ugin's Conjurant from your library.

654-1479-5700-5701-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-6529.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
